cards.example_en: They construct a model bridge during science class.
cards.example_zh: 他们在科学课上搭建一座桥的模型。

cards.example_en: We consult the coach before changing the match plan.
cards.example_zh: 更改比赛方案之前，我们会先和教练商量。

cards.example_en: New evidence may contradict the earlier explanation of how the fire started.
cards.example_zh: 新证据可能与早先关于火灾如何发生的解释相矛盾。

cards.example_en: Local families contribute food and clothes to the winter relief centre.
cards.example_zh: 当地家庭向冬季救济中心捐献食物和衣物。

cards.example_en: The controversial plan to widen the road divided opinion across the town.
cards.example_zh: 拓宽道路这项有争议的计划使全镇意见出现了分歧。

cards.example_en: For convenience, many passengers buy tickets on their phones before travelling.
cards.example_zh: 为了方便，许多乘客在出行前用手机购买车票。

cards.example_en: A simple drawing can convey an idea when words are hard to find.
cards.example_zh: 当难以找到合适的词语时，一幅简单的图画可以传达想法。

cards.example_en: The corporation employs thousands of workers in factories across the country.
cards.example_zh: 这家公司在全国各地的工厂雇用了数千名工人。

cards.example_en: A small correction in the map saved the hikers from taking the wrong path.
cards.example_zh: 地图上的一处小修正使徒步者没有走错路。

cards.example_en: A corrupt official accepted money and ignored the safety rules.
cards.example_zh: 一名腐败官员收受钱财，并忽视了安全规定。

cards.example_en: The cosy cafe by the station serves hot soup on cold evenings.
cards.example_zh: 车站旁这家舒适的咖啡馆在寒冷的晚上供应热汤。

cards.example_en: Children played football in the courtyard until it grew too dark.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们在院子里踢足球，直到天色变得太暗。

cards.example_en: Criminal damage to the lockers was reported before lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭前，有人报告储物柜被人故意破坏了。

cards.example_en: Turn left at the crossroads and you will see the hospital entrance.
cards.example_zh: 在十字路口向左转，你就会看到医院的入口。

cards.example_en: She cut the cheese into a small cube and placed it on the plate.
cards.example_zh: 她把奶酪切成一个小方块，放在盘子上。

cards.example_en: The tank holds about two cubic metres of water when it is full.
cards.example_zh: 水箱装满时大约能容纳两立方米的水。

cards.example_en: Travellers should check the local currency before they exchange money abroad.
cards.example_zh: 旅客在国外兑换钱币之前，应当先了解当地货币。

cards.example_en: First aid was added to the curriculum after the sports day.
cards.example_zh: 运动会之后，急救被加进了课程。

cards.example_en: The toddler calls Daddy and holds up his arms to be lifted.
cards.example_zh: 小孩喊爸爸，并举起胳膊要人抱。

cards.example_en: The dam holds back the river and supplies water to nearby farms.
cards.example_zh: 水坝拦住河水，并向附近的农田供水。

cards.example_en: He had to dash across the platform to catch the last evening train.
cards.example_zh: 他不得不冲过站台，去赶当晚的末班火车。

cards.example_en: At dawn, fishermen left the harbour and headed toward the open sea.
cards.example_zh: 黎明时分，渔民离开港口，驶向大海。

cards.example_en: One kind deed can change a stranger's difficult day for the better.
cards.example_zh: 一件善举就能让陌生人难挨的一天变得好一些。

cards.example_en: She deliberately left her phone in the bag during the whole examination.
cards.example_zh: 她故意把手机放在包里，整个考试期间都没拿出来。

cards.example_en: She will dedicate this song to her mother.
cards.example_zh: 她要把这首歌献给妈妈。

cards.example_en: We left a deposit so the shop would hold the bike until Friday.
cards.example_zh: 我们付了押金，商店才把自行车留到星期五。

cards.example_en: Her devotion to community service earned respect from every neighbor.
cards.example_zh: 她对社区服务的奉献赢得了每位邻居的尊敬。

cards.example_en: Choosing between a sports scholarship and a science program created a real dilemma.
cards.example_zh: 在体育奖学金和理科项目之间做选择，造成了真正的两难。

cards.example_en: Plants absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen during daylight hours.
cards.example_zh: 植物在白天吸收二氧化碳并释放氧气。

cards.example_en: After four years of study, she finally received her college diploma.
cards.example_zh: 经过四年学习，她终于拿到了大学文凭。

cards.example_en: The disgusting mould on the bread meant we threw it away.
cards.example_zh: 面包上恶心的霉让我们把它扔掉了。

cards.example_en: He stored family photos on a single disc and kept it in a drawer.
cards.example_zh: 他把家庭照片存在一张光盘上，并放进抽屉里。

cards.example_en: There is a clear distinction between weather forecasts and climate trends.
cards.example_zh: 天气预报和气候趋势之间有明显的区别。

cards.example_en: Teachers distribute the test papers at nine o'clock.
cards.example_zh: 老师们在九点分发试卷。

cards.example_en: Their divorce was settled calmly so the children felt less anxious.
cards.example_zh: 他们的离婚处理得很平静，所以孩子们没那么焦虑。

cards.example_en: Lights in our dorm go out at eleven on ordinary school nights.
cards.example_zh: 平时晚上十一点，我们宿舍就熄灯。

cards.example_en: One drawback of living downtown is the constant noise at night.
cards.example_zh: 住在市中心的一个缺点是夜里噪音不断。

cards.example_en: The history essay is due before the winter holiday begins.
cards.example_zh: 历史作文在寒假开始之前必须交。

cards.example_en: Good schools educate children from many different towns.
cards.example_zh: 好学校会教育来自许多不同城镇的孩子。

cards.example_en: Mom sliced an eggplant and cooked it with garlic and tomatoes.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈把一个茄子切片，和蒜、西红柿一起烹煮。

cards.example_en: Please do not embarrass your teammate when he misses an easy shot.
cards.example_zh: 队友投篮没进时，请不要让他难堪。

cards.example_en: Travelers visit the embassy when they need to renew a passport.
cards.example_zh: 旅行者需要换发护照时会去大使馆。

cards.example_en: Next year, builders will enlarge the laboratory for extra science classes.
cards.example_zh: 明年，施工人员将扩建实验室，以便增加科学课。

cards.example_en: My enquiry about lost property was answered within one school day.
cards.example_zh: 我关于失物的询问在一个上学日内得到了回复。

cards.example_en: During the talk, the entire class stayed silent for the guest scientist.
cards.example_zh: 讲座期间，全班都为客座科学家保持安静。

cards.example_en: It became evident that regular practice improved her spoken English.
cards.example_zh: 很明显，经常练习提高了她的英语口语。

cards.example_en: Biologists study the evolution of birds from ancient reptiles.
cards.example_zh: 生物学家研究鸟类从古代爬行动物进化而来的过程。

cards.example_en: A medical examination showed that his eyesight had remained stable.
cards.example_zh: 一次体检表明他的视力一直保持稳定。

cards.example_en: His explanation of the graph used one simple story about rainfall.
cards.example_zh: 他对这张图的解释，只用了一个关于降雨的简单故事。

cards.example_en: Before the relay, the coach gave explicit instructions to every runner.
cards.example_zh: 接力赛前，教练给每位选手下达了明确的指示。

word.example_en: Quiet reading can contribute to a better score.
word.example_zh: 安静阅读有助于取得更好的成绩。

word.example_en: The delay is due to the storm.
word.example_zh: 延误是由暴风雨造成的。
